sourceNotes: 新增 App 与 Homebrew 管理，可搜索应用、查看版本、大小、架构、上次打开时间与来源
能耗页新增 App CPU 能耗排行与睡眠阻止应用，帮助识别较耗电的应用和阻止休眠的原因
Magpie 额度新增账户身份、套餐到期与重置卡信息，可查看剩余重置卡数量和到期时间
电池页更名为能耗并整合温度
关闭基础监控后保留页面入口与硬件信息，停止实时指标、相关告警和新增历史
优化应用清单缓存与 Homebrew 界面反馈，复用未变化的元数据、批量更新体积并改善图标缓存
修复 Homebrew 筛选与空状态提示不准确的问题
修复清理与 Homebrew 操作的超时、取消及收尾问题
完善自动更新检查与通知诊断日志

en: Add App and Homebrew management: search apps and view their version, size, architecture, last opened time and source; browse Formula / Cask packages with installation dates, descriptions and manual-install or dependency classifications, and confirm updates or uninstalls. Enable the app feature by default while preserving existing disabled preferences

Add per-app CPU energy rankings and sleep-preventing apps to Energy, grouping helper processes with their apps and showing sleep-prevention reasons. Rankings cover readable CPU energy only, excluding GPU, display and other power use, and collection runs on demand while the page is open

Add Magpie account identity, plan expiry and reset-card details, including remaining cards and expiry dates; choose among connected AI providers for the menu bar and preserve existing provider selections on upgrade

Rename Battery to Energy and integrate temperatures, combine battery status with health and charge history with power usage, and arrange app energy, temperatures, sleep-preventing apps and Bluetooth devices in two columns. Keep the separate fan entry and existing control behavior

Keep page entries and hardware information when basic monitoring is disabled, while stopping live metrics, related alerts and new history records; disabling energy collection still allows basic battery and Bluetooth information, with power sampling independent of the fan feature

Improve app inventory caching and Homebrew feedback: reuse unchanged metadata, batch size updates and improve icon caching; refine search, filters and action buttons and briefly show specific successful results, reducing repeated scans and list refreshes when reopening the page

Fix Homebrew filter and empty-state messages, distinguish no available updates from no search results and add installation dates, descriptions and install classifications; correct Cask running-state detection and symlink size measurement and protect running apps and XStats itself

Fix timeouts, cancellation and completion handling in cleanup and Homebrew operations; confirmed Homebrew writes finish after the page closes, failures restore the inventory with diagnostic guidance and cancelled reads promptly release subprocesses

Improve automatic update and notification diagnostics by logging actual scheduling, feed failover, check results and reasons notifications were not sent, helping investigate missing new-version notifications
